steps.title: Initialize Android Project Structure
steps.description: Sets up the basic Android project files including the manifest and build configuration with the new package name and app name.

steps.title: Define Subject Data Model
steps.description: Creates the Subject class to represent study subjects with an ID and name.

steps.title: Define Task Data Model
steps.description: Creates the Task class to represent study tasks with an ID, associated subject, title, description, due date, priority, and completion status.

steps.title: Define Reminder Data Model
steps.description: Creates the Reminder class to represent notifications for tasks, including ID, associated task ID, message, and reminder time.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Develops StudyPlannerDatabaseHelper for managing SQLite operations for Subjects, Tasks, and Reminders (CRUD operations and search/filter).

steps.title: Create Main Activity Layout (Subject List)
steps.description: Designs the layout for MainActivity, which will display a list of all study subjects and a button to add new ones.

steps.title: Create Subject List Item Layout
steps.description: Designs the layout for a single subject item displayed in the main list.

steps.title: Implement Subject Adapter
steps.description: Creates a custom ArrayAdapter to efficiently display Subject objects in the MainActivity's ListView.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity (Subject List Management)
steps.description: Develops the core logic for MainActivity to load, display, and add subjects, handling user interactions.

steps.title: Create Subject Detail/Tasks List Layout
steps.description: Designs the layout for SubjectDetailActivity, showing subject name and a list of tasks for that subject.

steps.title: Create Task List Item Layout
steps.description: Designs the layout for a single task item, including its title, due date, priority, and completion status.

steps.title: Implement Task Adapter
steps.description: Creates a custom ArrayAdapter to efficiently display Task objects within SubjectDetailActivity's ListView.

steps.title: Implement Subject Detail Activity (Tasks Management)
steps.description: Develops SubjectDetailActivity to display tasks for a subject, add new tasks, and mark task completion, including subject editing.

steps.title: Create Task Detail Layout (Add/Edit Task)
steps.description: Designs the layout for TaskDetailActivity, allowing users to input/edit task title, description, due date, and priority.

steps.title: Implement Task Detail Activity
steps.description: Develops TaskDetailActivity for handling task creation, editing, and deletion, interacting with the database.

steps.title: Implement Reminder Broadcast Receiver
steps.description: Creates a BroadcastReceiver to handle alarm triggers and display notifications for reminders.

steps.title: Add Reminder Setup and Management
steps.description: Integrates functionality to set and cancel reminders for tasks within TaskDetailActivity using AlarmManager.

steps.title: Update Android Manifest
steps.description: Adds declarations for new activities, the broadcast receiver, and necessary permissions to the AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Building Student Study Planner
steps.description: The final step to compile and build the Android application.
